note: WAEC Literature round 6 (R31 top-up): anaphora, chiasmus, conceit, malapropism, innuendo, cliche, cacophony; anthology, colloquialism, suspense; epistolary, picaresque, bildungsroman, in medias res; stream of consciousness, internal conflict, third-person limited; comedy of manners, morality play, stage directions, closet drama; pastoral, the iamb; The Gods Are Not to Blame, Song of a Goat, Piano and Drums, Diop's Africa, God's Bits of Wood, The Beautyful Ones, Willy Loman, Animal Farm allegory, Antony's oration, Macbeth, Lord of the Flies, The Road Not Taken. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-5, NECO Literature (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
